right_before_0.name: Sweat
right_before_0.text: I see I can always count on you mortal to make the right decision.

right_before_2.name: Sour
right_before_2.text: If your just going to agree with whatever Sweaty says whats the point of me being here. Am I here just to watch you give up your livelyhood to some punk tree.

right_before_4.name: Sweat
right_before_4.text: No need to overreact. Let's just keep on going. Lord Pasta is sitting on his throne right now waiting for us.

01.name: Sweat
01.text: Thanks for siding with me this time mortal. I knew you weren't such a dunderhead after all.

03.name: Sour
03.text: Hmph. I'll let it slide this time since you went left last time but don't make it a habit lumberer

04.name: Narrator
04.text: As the group makes their way along the trail they come up to a small river were the bridge has been destroyed.

06.name: Sour
06.text: Ha ha ha. Sweaty you must be cursed or something. First the fallen tree now a broken bridge. This is why we should have went left.

07.name: Sour
07.text: Oh that's unlucky. What are the chances that the direction you picked would lead us to a broken bridge. What a shame.

08.name: Lumberjack
08.text: I guess we'll just have to turn around and go the other way.

10.name: Sour
10.text: What do you mean no. Can't you see the broken bridge.

11.name: Sweat
11.text: I do see it and we are going to fix it.

12.name: Sour
12.text: How I don't even have any hands.

14.name: Sour
14.text: Magic. But we're restriced on our use since we lost our magical licences cheating at musical chairs.

15.name: Sweat
15.text: We might be restricted but the mortal isn't.

16.name: Sour
16.text: But the lumberer can't use any magic.

17.name: Sweat
17.text: That's why we're going to channel our magic through him.

18.name: Sour
18.text: That's crazy. The lumberer will die.

19.name: Sweat
19.text: That's a price I'm willing to pay.

21.name: Sweat
21.text: Don't worry mortal just do what I say and you'll probably be fine.

24.name: Narrator
24.text: Use the 'wasd' or arrow keys in time with the beat to channel the magic.
